doan_van.noi_dung:
My best friend Linh and I grew up in the same small town. Ten years ago, we moved to London for university. I lived there for five years as a student, but Linh returned home right after we graduated. Lately, we have not spent much time together. I haven’t seen her recently because of our busy work schedules.

Last week, Linh came to visit me in London. We talked about how our lives have changed since our student days. Linh got married three years ago, and she has a wonderful family now. She’s worked at her school since 2020, and she really loves teaching. Her parents decided to retire last year, so they moved to a quiet village. So far, they have enjoyed their peaceful life there.

My life has changed a lot, too. I’ve lived here for five years, and my English has improved a lot because I use it every day. Up to now, I have completed many interesting projects with my international team.

How long have you known your best friend? Although Linh and I live far apart now, our friendship stays the same. Seeing her last week brought back many happy memories.

phat_am:
- **since** /sɪns/ có 2 âm /s/ — người Việt hay nuốt âm cuối thành “sin”.
- **for** khi không nhấn đọc yếu là /fə/: *I’ve lived here **fə** five years.*
- **worked** /wɜːkt/ vs **walked** /wɔːkt/ — chú ý nguyên âm.
luu_y:
**① for vs since**

- **for** + **khoảng thời gian**: for 3 years, for two weeks, for a long time
- **since** + **mốc bắt đầu**: since 2020, since Monday, since I was a child

> ❌ since 3 years → ✅ **for** 3 years

**② Câu có “for/since” ở hiện tại hoàn thành nghĩa là việc VẪN ĐANG tiếp diễn.**
*I’ve worked here for 5 years* = vẫn đang làm.
*I worked here for 5 years* = đã nghỉ.

**③ “this week / today / this year” đi với present perfect** nếu khoảng thời gian đó **chưa kết thúc**:
*I’ve seen him twice this week.* (tuần chưa hết)
*I saw him twice last week.* (tuần đã hết)

**④ Câu hỏi How long → luôn present perfect.**
❌ How long do you live here? → ✅ How long **have** you **lived** here?

> Đây là lỗi rất phổ biến vì tiếng Việt hỏi “Bạn sống ở đây bao lâu rồi?” ở thì hiện tại.

**⑤ Sau “It’s the first time…” dùng present perfect:**
*It’s the first time I **have been** here.*

**⑥ Câu chuyện điển hình: mở bằng present perfect, kể chi tiết bằng past simple.**
*I’ve been to Japan. **I went** there in 2019 and **stayed** for two weeks.*
